organizations.name: Michigan Data Science Team
organizations.description:
The Michigan Data Science Team is the world's first competitive collegiate data science team, founded at the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor. MDST's mission is to promote campus interest in data science and educate students about the practical applications of data science. 

Core Responsibilities:
● Management of our registered student organization account.
● Budgeting for MDST sponsored events.
● Handling reimbursements and keeping track of people who go on MDST funded travel.
● Ordering food for weekly meetings, workshops and project sessions.
